lines.en: Tamara, I failed the chemistry quiz, and I feel so embarrassed. If I had revised more, I would have passed it easily.
lines.pt: Tamara, reprovei no teste de química e estou morrendo de vergonha. Se eu tivesse revisado mais, teria passado facilmente.

lines.en: Oh no, I'm sorry. If you had asked me, I would have lent you my notes from the lectures.
lines.pt: Ai, sinto muito. Se você tivesse me pedido, eu teria emprestado minhas anotações das aulas.

lines.en: I know, but I was too embarrassed. Honestly, I wish I had started earlier instead of watching series every night.
lines.pt: Eu sei, mas tive vergonha. Sinceramente, queria ter começado antes em vez de ver séries toda noite.

lines.en: Don't be so hard on yourself. It's only one quiz, and there's a retake at the end of the semester, isn't there?
lines.pt: Não seja tão dura consigo mesma. É só um teste, e tem uma segunda chance no fim do semestre, não tem?

lines.en: There is, but it counts for only half. I need a ninety on the final to keep my scholarship, and the formulas still confuse me.
lines.pt: Tem, mas vale só metade. Preciso de noventa na prova final para manter minha bolsa, e as fórmulas ainda me confundem.

lines.en: Then let's study together. I'm good at balancing equations, and you can quiz me on the history assignment in return.
lines.pt: Então vamos estudar juntas. Sou boa em balancear equações, e você pode me testar no trabalho de história em troca.

lines.en: Really? You'd do that? Okay, but I get distracted easily, so I'll probably bring snacks and ask for a break every twenty minutes.
lines.pt: Sério? Você faria isso? Tá, mas eu me distraio fácil, então provavelmente vou trazer lanches e pedir pausa a cada vinte minutos.

lines.en: Fine, snacks are allowed. We'll start tomorrow at four in the library, and no phones on the table. Deal?
lines.pt: Tudo bem, lanches são permitidos. Começamos amanhã às quatro na biblioteca, e nada de celular na mesa. Combinado?

lines.en: Deal. I feel some relief already, to be honest. There's no point regretting it now, so I'd better focus on the next exam.
lines.pt: Combinado. Já sinto algum alívio, para ser sincera. Não adianta me arrepender agora, então é melhor me concentrar na próxima prova.

lines.en: Exactly. By the way, I just watched The History Boys, and the teacher's speech made me think about studying differently.
lines.pt: Exatamente. Aliás, acabei de ver Os Rapazes da História, e o discurso do professor me fez pensar em estudar de outra forma.

lines.en: I love that movie! Let's watch it after the exam, as a reward. Popcorn's on me, since you're saving my semester.
lines.pt: Adoro esse filme! Vamos assistir depois da prova, como recompensa. A pipoca é por minha conta, já que você está salvando meu semestre.

facts.label: 3º condicional
facts.sub: If I had revised, I would have passed. If I hadn’t asked, I wouldn’t have known.

facts.label: If + had + particípio
facts.sub: Use if + past perfect na oração condicional e would have + particípio no resultado: If I had revised more, I would have passed. Em português: “se eu tivesse revisado, teria passado”. É irreal e se refere ao passado.

facts.label: hadn’t, wouldn’t have
facts.sub: Negativo: If I hadn’t talked to him, I would have failed. Resultado negativo: I wouldn’t have passed. Não use would na oração com if.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: If I had revised, I would have passed is a third conditional.
We say “If I would have revised”.
items.why: We say If I had revised.

items.s: The if clause uses the past perfect.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: If I had revised, I would have passed is a third conditional. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “If I would have revised”. → Falso (We say If I had revised.)
The if clause uses the past perfect. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: After a difficult quiz · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a cold afternoon in Chicago. Esme leaves the chemistry classroom slowly. She holds a quiz with a red mark. Leo waits for her in the corridor. Other students talk about the results. Esme sighs and sits on a bench.

“Leo, I failed the chemistry quiz. If I had revised more, I would have passed it easily.” says Esme. “Oh no, Esme. If you had asked me, I would have lent you my notes from the lectures.” says Leo. “I know, but I was too embarrassed. Honestly, I wish I had started earlier instead of watching series every night.” says Esme.
